QUOTE: "rendered only when hasSearch is true (index.tsx:128)" and "If `hasSearch` is false, `NavigationSearch` is never mounted, so the ref stays `null`. Any caller that passes a ref without `hasSearch` gets nothing."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows NavigationHeader forwarding its ref to NavigationSearch, which is rendered only when hasSearch is true, and says the ref stays null otherwise.
